review.description: Compared maintain-flow-contracts specification and catalog contract with main; authored scenarios and dependency ownership are unchanged. Bounded SHA-256 reads affect verification resource use only.
review.implementation: The contributor verification still binds file descriptors and checks identity before/after reading; only digest buffering changes. Existing receipt tests reject changed source/assertion inputs without reconciliation. New bounded-read tests cover empty and multi-buffer content, while alias memoization, restored writes, FIFO substitution, cancellation and descriptor cleanup assertions remain active.
review.tests: Existing receipt tests reject changed source/assertion inputs without reconciliation.
